claims.claim_text: The indexed Belgian lieutenant Alfons Blonttrock is a high-confidence match to OSS SI figure Alfonse Blontrock, also documented under the mission name Jan Denis.
claims.evidence_excerpt: their given names were Alfonse Blontrock and Jan Blocks respectively
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The rare index name and Belgian status align with an official SI awards-board entry and scholarship identifying Alfonse Blontrock as Jan Denis of the Doctor mission.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The rare surname, Belgian nationality, OSS SI context, and near-exact first-name spelling support a high-confidence identity match; the institutional source does not print the index's lieutenant grade.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources document wartime OSS activity and an approved Distinguished Service Cross recommendation, but not a genuine pre-OSS employer or predecessor affiliation.
claims.match_notes: Alfonse Blontrock and Jan Denis are retained as documented variants. Optische Werke in Munich is excluded because the thesis explicitly presents it as operational cover rather than real employment.
